task_title: QA battery evidence lands inside the repo-under-test (release clean-tree precheck reads dirty)
task_criteria: Measured 2026-11-22T22:20Z: the lore-qa battery tick lore-qa-2026-11-22-20-12-17 left the checkout dirty with 168K of untracked harness residue under .coding-hermes/evidence/qa-20261122T202851Z/ (manifest.json, evidence.jsonl with 29 battery rows, plus a qa-logs tarball). No tracked file references that path, no .gitignore rule covers it, and it is the same residue class .gitignore already documents for .gitreins/verdicts/ and .digest/ — so scripts/release.sh's clean-tree precheck reads dirty after every battery for a reason no reviewer can act on.

No tracked file references that path, no .gitignore rule covers it, and it is the same residue class .gitignore already documents for .gitreins/verdicts/ and .digest/ — so scripts/release.sh's clean-tree precheck reads dirty after every battery for a reason no reviewer can act on.
items.detail: Defect reproduced and remediated at the demanded surface. RED control (committed docs/qa/evidence/run-LORE-HYGIENE-20261122/BEFORE-red-control.txt, HEAD 2d28070) shows `git status --porcelain` listing `?? .coding-hermes/evidence/` and release.sh refusing rc=1. Fix: .gitignore:55-57 adds `.coding-hermes/evidence/` inside the existing Agent-harness residue block that already documents .digest/ and .gitreins/verdicts/ (commit 035ee31). Live verification: `git check-ignore -v .coding-hermes/evidence/qa-probe-x/evidence.jsonl` → `.gitignore:57:.coding-hermes/evidence/` rc=0; `git status --porcelain | grep coding-hermes/evidence` → no match (rc=1) while the probe existed on disk. scripts/release.sh:31-35 precheck is `git status --porcelain`; live `bash scripts/release.sh --dry-run` now refuses only on unrelated working-tree state (.coding-hermes/board/*.jsonl modified, .gitreins/history/2026-11-25/6a12c1ea untracked) — the evidence path no longer appears. Regression tests ran fresh in this conversation: pytest tests/test_lore_hygiene_evidence_residue.py + test_qalore7_gitignore_evidence.py → `4 passed in 0.68s`; full suite `588 passed` in prior stage (pyproject testpaths=tests, test-count.txt=588). The original residue payload was moved intact out-of-tree: ~/.hermes/qa/evidence/lore/qa-20261122T202851Z/ contains manifest.json, evidence.jsonl, logs/ at 164K, alongside qa-20261123T144739Z and qa-20261124T210609Z; the legacy in-repo directory no longer exists (ls .coding-hermes/ → board, dogfood-log.md, waves only). Harness half is proven in committed harness-edit-gates.txt: new persist root ~/.hermes/qa/evidence/<project>/<tick>/, deployed suite 13/13 PASS vs fixed harness, RED vs backup reproducing exactly this defect (FAIL: arm3 EVIDENCE-DIR INSIDE the repo...
